stories.title: Extension scaffold with manifest.json
acceptanceCriteria: manifest.json exists with Manifest V3 format, permissions for storage and activeTab
manifest.json declares content_scripts matching makerworld.com edit page URLs
manifest.json declares options_page pointing to options/options.html
manifest.json declares service_worker as background/background.js
Extension loads in chrome://extensions developer mode without errors
All required directories exist: background/, content/, options/, icons/

stories.title: Shared constants and storage utilities
acceptanceCriteria: shared/constants.js exports PRESETS object with ZhiPu and DeepSeek configurations (apiUrl, modelName)
shared/constants.js exports DEFAULT_CONFIG with empty apiKey and 'zhipu' as default preset
shared/storage.js exports getConfig() that reads from chrome.storage.local
shared/storage.js exports saveConfig(config) that writes to chrome.storage.local
shared/storage.js exports getCache(key) and setCache(key, value) for translation caching

stories.title: Options page for API configuration
acceptanceCriteria: options/options.html has form with: API Key input, preset selector (ZhiPu/DeepSeek/Custom), custom endpoint URL input
Custom endpoint URL input is hidden when preset is ZhiPu or DeepSeek, shown when Custom
Options page loads saved config on open and populates form fields
Save button persists config to chrome.storage.local via storage.js helpers
Visual feedback on save (e.g., 'Saved!' message)
options/options.css provides clean, usable styling

stories.title: Content script injects translate buttons into input fields
acceptanceCriteria: content/content.js targets all textarea and input[type=text] elements on the page
Each matched input field gets an inline translate icon button positioned inside-right of the field
Translate button uses a CSS class for styling, does not break existing page layout
content/content.css styles the translate button as a small icon (translate/globe icon via SVG or unicode)
Buttons are added on DOMContentLoaded and also observe dynamically added elements via MutationObserver
Click on translate button retrieves the input field's current value

stories.title: Translation via LLM API with caching
acceptanceCriteria: background/background.js exposes chrome.runtime.onMessage handler for 'translate' action
translate handler reads config (apiKey, preset/endpoint) from storage
If apiKey is empty, returns error message asking user to configure in options page
Calls OpenAI-compatible chat completions API with system prompt for Chinese-to-English translation
Uses content hash as cache key; checks cache before calling API
On successful API response, caches the translation result and returns translated text
On API error, returns meaningful error message
Content script receives translated text and sets input field value, dispatches input event for React compatibility

stories.title: End-to-end integration and polish
acceptanceCriteria: Full flow works: open options → set API key → select preset → save → go to edit page → click translate → see English text
Translation button shows loading state (spinner/disabled) while API call is in progress
If API key not configured, clicking translate shows alert directing to options page
Cached translations return instantly without API call on second click of same content
manifest.json includes appropriate icons (placeholder SVG icons are acceptable)
